# SaveTheX (savethex.com)

Free online X / Twitter video downloader.

## Product
- Download public X and Twitter videos as MP4
- Download Twitter / X GIFs
- Download ended X live replays (remuxed to MP4)
- Replace-domain shortcut: swap x.com → savethex.com
- Optional PWA with share target on mobile
- No account required; no watermark added by SaveTheX

## Constraints
- Only public posts
- Not affiliated with X Corp. / Twitter
